evidence.method: Independent source track/pattern parsing, checked against executed score reads, instrument onsets, scheduled SR writes, pattern selections and loop restores across two complete score cycles.

diagnostic.classification: Pinned diagnostic adapter; not a production-auditor pass

score.limits: Complete selected recurring SID score from initialization, with no independently authored ending. Instrument waveform/PWM/filter synthesis is outside this score model. Notes name score roots, not every audible attack; frequencyWord excludes active instrument/effect modulation. No bus-timing, original-song section coverage or listening-acceptance claim.
